newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB falls sharply, becomes top percentage loser.
newsitem.headline: NCB falls sharply, becomes top percentage loser.

text.p: Shares of Nippon Credit Bank (NCB) fell sharply on Wednesday afternoon, brokers said.
The bank, which announced major restructuring plans on Tuesday, was the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
By 0358 GMT, NCB's shares had fallen 30 yen, or 11.49 percent, to 231.
Brokers said continued rumours surrounding NCB's financial health hit the share price in the afternoon.
There was vague market talk that the bank would further reduce the size of its capital, but a spokesman for NCB denied the rumours.
